name: lamp-spec-checks
description: v0.31.8.0 visual verification: the Lamp specification group in the Checks panel, BOTH arms. The default flat used to ship IP20 ceiling lights in its bathrooms, so this scenario originally just asserted the advisory fired out of the box — which coupled it to the app's own content being non-compliant. That content is now specified wet-rated, so the scenario checks the clean state first and then constructs the failing arm by overriding one bath light back to IP20. Pro mode.

steps.name: assert-shipped-content-is-clean
steps.eval: (function(){ const badges=[...document.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(badges.includes('IP rating')) throw new Error('the shipped flat still raises an IP finding — its bathroom lights should be specified IP44. Badges: '+badges.join(' | ')); if(badges.includes('Colour temp.')) throw new Error('the shipped flat still raises a colour-temperature finding. Badges: '+badges.join(' | ')); })()

steps.name: override-one-bath-light-to-ip20
steps.eval: (function(){ const s=window.__store.getState(); const light=s.items.find(i=>i.id==='default-bath1-light'); if(!light) throw new Error('default-bath1-light missing from the shipped flat'); s.updateItemProps('default-bath1-light', { lampIp: 20, lampCct: 3000 }); })()

steps.name: assert-advisory-fires-on-the-failing-arm
steps.eval: (function(){ const heads=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!heads.includes('Lamp specification')) throw new Error('no Lamp specification group after forcing IP20 in a wet room. Section heads: '+heads.join(' | ')); const badges=[...document.querySelectorAll('.badge')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!badges.includes('IP rating')) throw new Error('no IP rating finding after forcing IP20 — the check may be unreachable rather than satisfied. Badges: '+badges.join(' | ')); const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].find(e=>/Lamp specification/.test(e.textContent||'')); h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()

steps.name: assert-lighting-layers-group
steps.eval: (function(){ const heads=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].map(e=>(e.textContent||'').trim()); if(!heads.includes('Lighting layers')) throw new Error('no Lighting layers group. Heads: '+heads.join(' | ')); const h=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].find(e=>/Lighting layers/.test(e.textContent||'')); const txt=h.parentElement.textContent||''; if(!/Missing/.test(txt)) throw new Error('group present but names no missing layer'); h.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); })()
